why: The notes do not explain the grass-on-the-rooftops image. Clarke only says God had made the people weak and dismayed so Assyria could beat them. Jamieson-Fausset-Brown gives an outline of the passage, and Gill points to Isaiah for the explanation. None of them says what the grass on the roof means, so the idiom list's meaning (short-lived, withering in the sun) cannot be backed by the notes.
